headline: New MD builders for glycans and polymers; QM/MM maps hyaluronidase hydrolysis barrier
label: Molecular Dynamics Simulation Tools
summary: Recent preprints extend coarse-grained and glycan model-building tools while a published QM/MM study quantifies hyaluronan hydrolysis barriers.
synthesis: The dominant thread is simulation infrastructure and mechanistic MD for biomolecular systems. Two preprints extend input-generation tooling: the MAD server adds a polymer builder and an enhanced Martini database for coarse-grained modelling, and the GLYCAM Bacterial Carbohydrate Builder generates 3D bacterial glycan structures with AMBER MD input files. The published study applies QM/MM umbrella-sampling MD to snake venom Hyal-1, reporting a 20.34 kcal/mol barrier for a neutral Asp110 route, nearly half that of the ionised pathway. What is new is the extension of ready-to-simulate model generation to polymers and bacterial glycans, alongside a quantitative comparison of protonation-dependent hydrolysis barriers.
